about: breakout: next season a regular with a PFN score z 0.75+ over his established level (higher of this season's z shrunk to replacement and 3-season Marcel); base 2026; odds = logistic on shrunk z, workload, position + class curve, low-volume efficiency, recruiting grade, level (each passes leave-one-season-out 2019-2026; final t 7.93, 7/7 seasons). OPP/G = attempts (QB), carries + catches (RB), targets (WR, TE), snaps (EDGE, DT, LB) a game; seniors and workloads below the fit's range left out. no workload tiers: the change in workload did not predict next-season efficiency out of sample (t 0.35, 3/7 seasons on workloads up 25%+)
